title: BNY Mellon unit joins MiCA register as ESMA adds 15 providers
summary: BNY Mellon’s European subsidiary joined the MiCA register as ESMA added 15 CASPs, including banks and crypto platforms, in the third post-deadline update.

title: Brazilian police bust cocaine traffickers in crypto-linked transnational probe
summary: Brazilian police suspect the group of shipping around 6.5 metric tons of cocaine and laundering billions in Brazilian reals through crypto-enabled illicit money brokers.

title: Coinbase CEO touts agentic finance as Base tops 100M AI payments
summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong says AI agents will expand crypto adoption, pointing to Base, USDC and x402 as key pieces of agentic finance.

title: Triple-A confirms treasury-wallet breach after losses reach $11.8M
summary: The stablecoin payments company said client funds were unaffected and that the financial impact would be absorbed through its treasury reserves.

title: BitMart withdrawals appear to slow following wind-down announcement
summary: Users reported withdrawal delays and freeze notices as wallets attributed to BitMart fell to about $69 million and its BMX token extended an 81.5% weekly decline.

title: Garden Finance disables app as Blockaid reports $450,000 exploit
summary: Garden Finance said no user funds or smart contracts were affected after an attacker compromised an independent solver’s off-chain database and inserted fraudulent swap records.

title: Storj files for bankruptcy, explores equity path for tokenholders
summary: The decentralized storage provider says its network will continue operating during Chapter 11 as it explores a court-approved ownership mechanism for STORJ holders.

title: CLARITY hopes fade, BitMEX shuts as lawsuit looms: Hodler’s Digest, July 26
summary: Despite support from Goldman Sachs, Fidelity and law enforcement bodies, the Clarity Act’s chances dim. BitMEX to close as crypto consolidates into five big players.

title: WEMIX says attacker moved about $724,000 after contract breach
summary: WEMIX suspended bridges, liquidity-pool trading and several services after an attacker compromised a WEMIX$-linked contract and moved 724,198 USDC.e.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
